Name: Drive By
Author: 91BlaDe
Description:
Drive By minigame - Hit villagers with slingshot

Inspired by the Stardew Valley Trials

Hit F6 to start the game (Can be changed in config)

While the game is active, hitting a villager will score a point.  The leaderboard is shown in the top left.

Game can be played with either a time limit (in milliseconds) or a target limit.  Settings in the config file.
